Maya (sales): Handing off AuroraPay deal to CS. They signed for Private (VPC) + SSO. GA date requested: 2026-04-20. Buyer expressed concern about token-cost visibility and occasional high latency on longer prompts.

Ravi (CS): Thanks Maya. I'll lead onboarding. Need: SAML certs, customer VPC CIDR, list of high-throughput endpoints, and their network contact.

Maya (sales): Sharing SOW + compliance pack here: https://redwood.internal/docs/aurorapay-sow. Network lead is j.singh@aurorapay.com. SAML certs to follow today.

Nina (CSM): I'll run weekly enablement calls and own success metrics. Proposed first enablement: Tue 2026-03-23.

Akira (eng-oncall): Looping in for VPC & perf. Request their slow request logs (trace) and any reproducible prompt samples >1k tokens. Also they should whitelist 10.50.0.0/16 and open 443/8443.

Maya (sales): Customer prefers model pinning to maintain parity; asked about using gptx-7b-stable. Mentioned wanting reserved capacity if p95 latency <120ms for main route.

Ravi (CS): Action items:
- Maya: upload SAML cert + confirm network contact (due 2026-03-11)
- Akira: prepare VPC onboarding checklist and quick perf mitigations (due 2026-03-15)
- Nina: schedule enablement + send invite (due 2026-03-16)
- OpsBot: create internal ticket for perf monitoring

OpsBot: Created ticket INC-20260311-9910 for AuroraPay performance tracking.

Akira (eng-oncall): Quick mitigation: ask customer to enable prefix KV caching and reduce batch_hint to 1 for embedding-heavy flows. Example curl:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gptx-7b-stable","input":"<payload>","meta":{"batch_hint":1}}'
```
This should help p95 while we tune runtime configs.

Nina (CSM): AuroraPay also wants token-cost alerts and weekly latency reports. Can we provision a temp dashboard tagged customer:aurorapay with 30-day retention?

Akira (eng-oncall): Yes, we can. I'll request the dashboard and enable 30-day logs for onboarding. Will post load test CSV (p50/p95/p99) after staging deploy.

Ravi (CS): Noted renewal risk: customer said they would consider reserved capacity at renewal if SLA met. I'll add this to the renewal tracker and set an alert for two consecutive SLA misses.

Maya (sales): Uploaded certs: https://files.redwood.internal/secure/aurorapay/saml.pem :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Staging deploy scheduled: private-controlplane-provision for aurorapay on 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC.

Nina (CSM): Next steps for 48h: 1) confirm network allowlist, 2) staging validation by Akira, 3) send enablement invite. Posting updates here each Friday. :wave:
